as_of_note: US closes for Wed 4 Nov 2026, day after the midterms: Democrats won House and Senate. Dow +3.03% (+1,569.40) to 53,356.12, best day since Apr 2025; S&P 500 +1.58% to 7,688.62; Nasdaq +1.44%; Nasdaq 100 +0.91%; Russell 2000 +1.58%; SOX -3.13% to six-month low. WTI -8.29% to $88.12, Brent ~$94.60 after Vance blamed the Iran war for GOP losses. 10Y 4.89% (-8bp), 2Y 4.58%; DXY 101.53; gold $4,060.36 (+3.31%); VIX 16.61. ADP +86k, ISM services 54.5. Dec hike odds 86%. Data-center names hit (IREN -11%, HUT -23%). After hours APP ~+24%, QCOM -6.5%; evening futures flat to slightly up.

mood.reason: Broad relief rally after a decisive Democratic sweep (Dow +3%, best day since Apr 2025; VIX 16.61 from 20.83), oil -8% on hopes of ending the Iran war, yields lower. Tempered by a split AI trade (SOX six-month low, data-center names -10% to -23%) and 86% December hike odds.

risks: AI/data-center regulation: Texas governor-elect backs a data-center moratorium (Texas ~27% of US data-center GW per Wells Fargo); SOX at six-month low; neocloud and miner stocks (IREN -11%, HUT -23%) hit
Neocloud credit stress: CoreWeave 5Y CDS 1,139.7 (above 1,000 distress line); CoreWeave results 11 Nov
Hawkish Fed: Dec hike odds 86% despite softer ISM; Oct payrolls Fri (est 63k)
Iran: Trump says war continues; IRGC claims tankers mined near Hormuz (unconfirmed); oil could snap back on headlines
Policy noise: Democratic probes into Trump's crypto ventures (FT via @KobeissiLetter), Trump veto threats, Warren-led Senate Banking
Data/earnings: BoE (hike to 4.00% expected) and claims Thu; IREN, Airbnb results; QCOM -6.5% after hours

themes.title: Gridlock rally
themes.explanation: Democrats won both chambers; Trump accepted results. Dow +1,569 pts, S&P +1.58%; S&P has risen a year after each of the last 11 midterms (CNBC).

themes.title: Oil as the peace trade
themes.explanation: Vance said the Iran war cost the election; Schumer and Jeffries vowed to end it. WTI -8.29% to $88.12, Brent ~$94.60; 10Y breakeven fell to 2.26%.
